patch_description: Run the identical optimize pipeline (LP water-filling + corner-aware hill-climb + greedy growth pass) on two different seeds — the original wall-aligned hex lattice and the corner-anchored variant — and return the better result. This diversifies the local optimum the hill-climb lands in: the corner-anchored seed favors large corner circles with a small interior, while the wall-aligned seed spreads radius more evenly. Since the hill-climb only accepts strict LP-sum improvements, neither variant can fall below its own LP seed value, and keeping the best of the two can only help. Iterations per run are halved to keep total runtime near the previous ~9s budget.
